methodology.firstSeen: First successful Raven Eye observation, not the original release date.
methodology.publishedAt: Seller publication timestamp when exposed; not a verified mint launch date.
methodology.status: Seller feed observation at lastCheckedAt; a source outage or absent listing never implies sold out.
methodology.prices: Original seller currency; taxes, shipping, quantity tiers and local storefront conversion may differ. No currency conversion.
methodology.coverage: Bounded catalogue windows. Existing listings beyond those windows are rechecked in rotation; missing listings retain historical observations.
methodology.baseline: Initial imports do not create new-release alerts. New means first detected after that source's baseline.
